build_method: Isolated P2 target rebuild with the original CMake/Ninja TableGen, compile and link commands. All P2 target objects and the LLVM shared library were newly linked. The existing native frontend and host component archives were reused.
clean_recipe_check: Both patches applied successively to the pinned clean LLVM base. All four changed source files exactly matched the private build input.

clang_reduced_case.stock: cmps r0, #4 wcz; cmps r6, #0 wcz; if_z mov; if_nz mov; if_z jmp

port_host_regression: P2 overlay passed: conditional branch, quotient/remainder, 256 pointer encodings, four GETRND effects, four invalid operands

sdk_integration_original.reason: FileCheck expected the loop counter copy between CMP and JMP. The corrected backend snapshots the pre-increment counter before the call and compares that snapshot immediately before JMP.
